questions.question: When soldiers and officers came to arrest Jesus in the garden, what did Jesus do?

answers.text: Stepped forward and asked who they were looking for
Slipped away across the valley in the dark
Hid deeper in the garden with His disciples

questions.question: When Jesus told the soldiers who came to arrest Him, "I am He," they drew back and fell to the ground. True or false?
